stem: 4. Identify the following sets as null set or singleton set.
tamilStatus: pending original Tamil source transcription and independent editorial review

entries.question: A = {x : x ∈ N , 1 < x < 2}
steps: A natural number must be an integer at least 1.
There is no integer strictly between 1 and 2.

entries.question: B = The set of all even natural numbers which are not divisible by 2
steps: Every even natural number has the form 2k for some natural number k.
Hence every even natural number is divisible by 2.
entries.mathCheck: Even n implies n mod 2=0, contradicting condition.

entries.question: C = {0}.
steps: The number 0 is one element; {0} is not the empty set.

entries.question: D = The set of all triangles having four sides.
steps: By definition, a triangle has exactly three sides.
A four-sided polygon is not a triangle.
Therefore no figure satisfies the description.
